verdict.rationale: WooCommerce's first-party webhooks documentation says the store can send automatic event notifications to a URL of your choice. A user or developer configures webhooks that are triggered by site events, which covers the core of subscribing to events. The evidence is only two short doc snippets, so many details are not shown. Missing for 10: a list of supported event topics, evidence of payload signing, delivery retries or failure handling, evidence that webhooks can be managed programmatically via the REST API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
